<!-- head-1: body_md -->
Let $F$ be a differential field of characteristic zero and $\alpha\in F$. If the
equation $y'=\alpha$ has a solution in some elementary differential extension field of $F$
having the same subfield of constants, then there are constants $c_1,\ldots ,c_n\in F$ and
elements $u_1,\ldots,u_n,v\in F$ such that
$$\alpha=\sum_{i=1}^n c_i\frac{u_i'}{u_i}+v'.$$
<!-- end head-1 -->
